label: early copy steps of long sequences (5+ outputs still to go)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, never on original tokens or the <DEL> step. Activity sits on the first few copy steps after <DEL> (recall_idx 1-2, i.e. input is orig(0) or orig(1); 80% of mass) and only when the sequence is long (L>=7; L=9 has 61% of mass), so: copy steps with at least 5 outputs still to come. The largest activations are at recall_idx 1 with the fed-back input c, a or f (top examples are almost all c/a/f at the first copy step). Within that window magnitude depends strongly on which token is being fed back (c, a, f, x, n, 0, e, v, u, 1 are favored; for many others it does not fire), so precision is only about 0.43. A weaker secondary bump shows up on the last copy steps of L=9 sequences (t=16-17). Never fires at t<6, for L<=4, or on a token appearing for the first time.
